shared_or_similar_visual_information: A single short tick crossing a line segment
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The horizontal radius belongs to the equal-length group identified by single ticks and has the same length as the radius on the right. Right image: The horizontal radius belongs to the equal-length group identified by single ticks and has the same length as the slanted radius.
Rationales: Repeated single ticks encode equal lengths in both images; this item compares the meaning of the ticks, rather than the specific lengths.
